item.text: I’ll find the issue-created event and trace where handlers subscribe to it.

item.command: /bin/zsh -lc "rg -n 'subscribe|event-bus|issue\\.created' src/server src/lib; rg --files -g '*AGENTS.md' -g '*CLAUDE.md'; sed -n '1,240p' src/lib/event-bus.ts; sed -n '120,195p' src/server/services/search-service.ts; sed -n '55,95p' src/server/services/usage-service.ts; sed -n '95,140p' src/server/services/webhook-service.ts; sed -n '145,205p' src/server/services/activity-service.ts"
